substeps.title: Freeze inputs, methods and reproducibility contract

children.title: Freeze accepted H2 artifacts and the complete H3 verification matrix
Inventory authoritative electrical parameters, models, provenance and missing evidence
Freeze reproducible calculation/simulation toolchain, tolerances and pass/fail rules

substeps.title: Worst-case steady-state power and source budget

children.title: Enumerate legal USB, battery, charge and operating states
Calculate worst-case load and margin for every rail and domain
Check charge, discharge and steady thermal operating envelopes
Consolidate the DC budget and correct every failed margin
Model startup, orderly shutdown and hard FAULT_KILL shutdown
Model USB-to-battery handover, charger interaction and brownout
Model eFuse, load-switch, inrush and worst-case load steps
Verify watchdog, latch and retained fault-display timing
Consolidate transient and shutdown evidence
Verify display supply, backlight and direct-QSPI electrical corners
Verify codec, microphone, headset and speaker gain/noise/power corners
Verify IR drive, receive thresholds and thermal duty limits
Verify battery sensing, thermistors and analog fault thresholds
Consolidate analog-corner evidence

substeps.title: Digital interface, timing and level verification

children.title: Check voltage levels, pulls, reset defaults and no-back-power at every interface
Check bandwidth, latency and timing for display, storage, audio and radio buses
Check M1, U214, M5 Unit and service-boundary loading
Consolidate digital timing and level evidence

substeps.title: RF pre-layout constraints and coexistence model

children.title: Derive 50-ohm feed, connector, matching and loss constraints for every antenna path
Derive RF corridors, keepouts, reference-plane and return-current constraints
Verify one-active-group isolation, quiet-state and full 3x nRF24 concurrency assumptions
Consolidate RF pre-layout rules and physical-only measurements
Build worst-case board, battery and enclosure thermal model
Trace single faults through independent hardware shutdown and recovery
Verify the bounded 24-to-48-hour unattended operating envelope
Consolidate thermal and fault evidence
Cross-check every H3 result against H2 and downstream layout/bring-up consumers
Publish every residual physical-only uncertainty and required H5/H6/H8 evidence
Prepare formal H3 acceptance package
Record explicit user acceptance before H4

exit_criteria: Every H2 electrical claim that can be checked without fabricated hardware has reproducible evidence.
Every failed margin is corrected in its source artifact and all affected evidence is regenerated.
Every model input has authoritative provenance, tolerance and applicability limits.
Every remaining uncertainty is demonstrably physical-only and assigned to H5, H6 or H8.
No H3 result authorizes purchasing, PCB layout or fabrication.
